"""Exception window (rubric e: Exception window, 1 mark).

Owner: Xinyi H.

One small pop-up used by the other windows for every error: empty login fields,
wrong email format, wrong email or password, and a 5th subject."""

import tkinter as tk

class ExceptionWindow:

    def __init__(self, master, title, message):
        """A small window that shows title + message and an OK button that closes it."""
        super().__init__(master)
        self.title(title)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.configure(padx=24, pady=18)

        tk.Label(self, text=title, font=("Helvetica", 14, "bold"), fg="#c0392b").pack(pady=(0, 8))
        tk.Label(self, text=message, wraplength=280, justify="center").pack(pady=(0, 12))
        tk.Button(self, text="OK", width=10, command=self.destroy).pack()

        # Keep the pop-up on top of the window that opened it, and block that
        # window until the user clicks OK.
        self.transient(master)
        self.grab_set()
        self.focus_set()
        self.bind("<Return>", lambda _event: self.destroy())

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

class SubjectWindow:

    def __init__(self, master, student):
        """Lists the enrolled subjects with their id, mark and grade."""
        super().__init__(master)
        self.title("Enrolled Subjects")
        self.configure(padx=20, pady=16)
        tk.Label(self, text=f"{student.name}'s Subjects", font=("Helvetica", 14, "bold")).pack(pady=(0, 10))

        # One row per subject: ID, mark and grade. The grade comes from the shared
        # GradeCalculator, which runs when the Subject is created.
        table = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=("id", "mark", "grade"), show="headings",
                             height=student.MAX_SUBJECTS)
        for column, heading in (("id", "Subject ID"), ("mark", "Mark"), ("grade", "Grade")):
            table.heading(column, text=heading)
            table.column(column, width=100, anchor="center")
        for subject in student.subjects:

        tk.Button(self, text="Close", width=10, command=self.destroy).pack()
